item.title: My thoughts after using Clojure for about a month
item.description:
📝 More “batteries included” than Scheme Scheme was also built by committee, but you could argue it’s even more cohesive than Clojure. Ergonomic data structures One of the things that first drew me to Lisp is that it’s an “everything-is-a” language. Even though it’s a Lisp (don’t @ me), Clojure has a lot more syntax than say, Scheme.
🔗 Read more: https://www.acdw.net/clojure/

item.title: Gleam v1.17.0 Released
item.description:
📝 This release brings the gleam export escript command, which will compile the project, verify it has a valid main function, and build the escript file from the compiled bytecode. /my_project Hello from my_project. This has also enabled us to upgrade the "Fill labels" code action so that it works with constants too.
🔗 Read more: https://gleam.run/news/single-file-gleam-beam-programs-with-escript/

item.title: 4K years ago, Mohenjo-daro grew more equal over time
item.description:
📝 Home News Archaeology 4,000-year-old Mohenjo-daro study finds ancient city grew more equal over time by Dario Radley May 24, 2026For decades, archaeologists argued that cities grew alongside inequality. As the city developed, inequality dropped instead of rising. Mohenjo-daro followed another route.
🔗 Read more: https://archaeologymag.com/2026/05/mohenjo-daro-grew-more-equal-over-time/
